name: Altia Consultores, S.A.
summary: Altia Consultores, S.A. operates in the information and communication technologies (ICT) sector in Spain and internationally. The company offers artificial intelligence tailor-made solutions; hardware and software supply services; quality management solutions, including test management automation and DevOps; and robotic process automation solutions. It also provides cybersecurity solutions; data center and cloud services comprising cloud and managed services, business continuity, and security and connectivity solutions; low-code solutions; data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI); ECM and content management solutions; and GIS services and immersive contents solutions.
